verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so data-plane work (SQL, ingestion, querying) can be driven programmatically through a public, documented interface. Webhook destinations exist for alert rules. There is no evidence of a documented control-plane API for creating clusters, resizing compute, managing users, or configuring alerts. missing for 10: documented management/control-plane REST API (cluster provisioning, scaling, access and alert configuration), API reference with authentication/keys, independent or hands-on corroboration.
